scenarios.title: Delay reported, clarification answered (THR003 / SHP1013)
scenarios.brief: A vague delay gets one clarifying question; a stated time gets checked options; pick -> hold -> request -> coordinator confirms; the driver is told 'confirmed' only after that.

events.text: reset demo data, clock 10:00 frozen (275 rows)
I am late by one hour.
Does that mean you'll reach the gate around 12:00, or could the delay keep growing?  (10.0s)
I'll reach the gate at 11:10, traffic cleared.

Here are some options, not reserved yet:
1. Dock D2, 12:00-13:00
2. Dock D1, 13:00-14:00
3. Dock D3, 13:00-14:00

Which option would you like?  (4.5s)
Option 1
I have held Dock D2 for you from 12:00-13:00. This hold will expire in 5 minutes. Would you like to book it?  (3.0s)
Yes, request it
Requested, waiting for the warehouse. Keep your current slot until I confirm.  (2.8s)
So am I booked now?
Your request for Dock D2 from 12:00-13:00 is pending confirmation from the warehouse. You are not booked yet.  (3.0s)
confirms APT-1A1E22301793157 D2 12:00 -> CONFIRMED
Is it confirmed now?
Yes, your booking for Dock D2 from 12:00-13:00 is confirmed.  (2.6s)
